brief: The canvas displays complex networks of intersecting geometric paths beneath the surface. These tunnels are not static structures; they are dynamic conduits that continuously widen and fill with vibrant, flowing underground streams. The color palette emphasizes earthy, muted browns for the rock walls, vividly contrasted by deep blues and cyans representing the running water. The streams appear to move with constant, natural motion, giving the sense of vast, subterranean currents. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, that point immediately initiates a new segment of the tunnel network, causing the surrounding paths to widen and triggering the rapid formation of new, flowing streams at the intersection.

statement: This sketch visualizes an underground network of tunnels and flowing water streams. It depicts the dynamic interaction between solid rock walls—represented by brown, winding paths—and vibrant blue and cyan streams that flow through them. When a viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, that point initiates a new tunnel segment, causing surrounding paths to widen and triggering the formation of new streams at the intersection. The system creates a continuous sense of movement and growth, simulating how subterranean currents might evolve and expand from a single point of origin.
